_README: Ratchet baseline for GitHub Actions supply-chain pinning. A tag such as @v4 is a mutable pointer: whoever controls the action's repository can move it, so a tag-pinned third-party action is an unreviewed code-execution path into CI. Pinning to a 40-char commit SHA removes that. The tree is not fully pinned yet, so instead of a gate that cannot be turned on, tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_invariants.py enforces a ratchet: the count per action may only DECREASE, an action absent from this file must be SHA-pinned on first use, and this file must be re-tightened in the same change that converts a pin. Regenerate with: make pins-baseline
